name: smwgraphics-kitsunes-and-tanuki
title: Kitsunes and Tanuki
description:
Anorakun's Notes: Goombas and Koopas being replaced by mischievous Kitsunes and tricky Tanukis. Includes normal, net climbing koopas, super koopas, parachute goombas and special world koopas, as well. Credit to No Body The Dragon. Uses vanilla palette.

You can always tweak the palette to a color you enjoy.
